title: Tampa City Trolley Tour - THE ULTIMATE ALL-IN-ONE TOUR
includes: Comfortable Seating with soft cushions and complimentary water to keep you refreshed
Flexible Experience: Enclosed trolleys for comfort and protection from the elements when needed
Incredible Photo Ops: Enjoy plenty of Instagram-ready moments
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
• FREE authentic original Tampa Cuban sandwich tasting at the iconic Flan Factory in historic Ybor City, included with your ticket
• Tampa’s only open-air sightseeing trolley tour with unbeatable 360° views and fresh air
• One of Tampa’s best values for a guided sightseeing + tasting experience
• Explore Tampa’s most iconic districts in just 90 minutes to 2 hours including Ybor City, Downtown Tampa, Riverwalk, Channelside, and vibrant mural districts
• Discover Tampa’s rich cigar-making history, cultural landmarks, hidden gems, and fascinating local stories
• Complimentary bottled water included (BYOB friendly for adult guests)
• Comfortable cushioned seating aboard a custom-built premium trolley
• Incredible photo opportunities with waterfront views, historic architecture, public art, and city skyline backdrops
• Perfect for first-time visitors and locals alike wanting to experience the real Tampa beyond the usual tourist stops
